content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Beats online

The core issue for many digital creators is the reliance on third-party payment platforms that charge high fees. Platforms like Gumroad take 10% on every sale, which can significantly impact your revenue. For a product priced at $97, if you sell 100 units a month, the fee difference with NOWPayments' 0.5% fee retains an additional $921 for you. This means infrastructure sovereignty matters — it empowers you to keep your earnings without being tethered to exploitative platforms.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture enabling this seamless selling experience combines several free tools. You can host your site on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, utilizing Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend logic. Supabase or Google Sheets handles your order storage, while Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 delivers your digital files. With NOWPayments, crypto transactions are processed automatically, ensuring instant payment confirmation and file delivery, all without the need for a third party.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is built for digital creators in regions such as Nigeria, Kenya, and Venezuela, where traditional payment options are limited or non-existent. If you are an artist, musician, or educator looking to sell beats or courses, this solution allows you to operate independently. It is designed for those who want to take control of their digital commerce and build a sustainable income without the restrictions imposed by conventional platforms.
Retain more earnings by avoiding high platform fees.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Your online store's success hinges on the integration of several components. First, you need a reliable hosting platform; GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages works well. Next, employ Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for processing orders. Use NOWPayments for crypto payment processing, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies. Finally, ensure your products are stored in Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to facilitate immediate delivery to customers. Each piece plays a crucial role in creating a frictionless purchasing experience.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Begin by selecting your hosting platform — GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up your backend using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for processing orders. Integrate NOWPayments for accepting crypto payments. Store your product files in Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to ensure instant delivery. Finally, test your setup to confirm that everything works seamlessly before launching your store.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, use a combination of free hosting, backend logic, and crypto payment processing. Platforms like NOWPayments allow you to accept various cryptocurrencies with minimal fees. This approach empowers you to retain more of your earnings while delivering your digital products directly to customers.
Seamless crypto payments ensure instant processing.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're interested in selling digital products without the constraints of traditional payment systems, consider our Complete Builder Kit ($197). It includes all the blueprints and templates you need to deploy your own sovereign commerce stack. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to explore your options.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
